projects.title: VEX Robotics

blocks.text: I was the team captain, design, and programming lead for team 7614A, representing Newmarket High School. I was responsible for end-to-end development and design of the robot. We competed in four seasons of the VEX V5 Robotics Competition, achieving accalades on the regional and provincial scale. Some of my favorite high school memories are from robotics, and I will never forget the experiences or lessons it taught me.
Prototyped each subsystem in Fusion 360 before cutting metal.

items: Design award at 2025 Caution Tape Halloween Qualifier, awarded to the best-designed robot and the most professional approach to the engineering design process. (top 1.4% in the province)
Excellence award at 2025 Ontario VEX V5 Robotics Competition School Board Invitational, awarded to the highest-performing team at the event. (top 5% among public schools in the province)

projects.previewDesc: Built nine competition robots across four seasons, led a team of seven members, and directed my team to winning a total of 11 awards at the provincial level. Competed as Team 7614A.

images.heroCaption: My team at the 2025 Waterloo VEX Robotics Competition, where we won the Think Award and placed 2nd overall.

projects.title: 4 DOF Humanoid Arm
projects.previewDesc: Designed a 4 DOF humanoid lower arm, including forearm and wrist frames, with a focus on manufacturability and assembly. Performed torque calculations to ensure chosen actuators could handle required loads.

projects.title: Pure Pursuit Path Planner
projects.previewDesc: Designed, built, and programmed a holonomic robot to follow a path using a custom implementation of the Pure Pursuit algorithm.
